examples.label: Checkout progress list with the current step marked
examples.source:
<.component
  component_name="chelekom-content-wrapper"
  site="Global"
  id="checkout-steps"
  role="list"
  class="max-w-xs space-y-4 rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 p-5 dark:border-neutral-700"
>
  <.component
    component_name="chelekom-content-item"
    site="Global"
    id="checkout-step-cart"
    icon="hero-check"
    icon_class="size-4 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400"
    title="Step 1"
    title_class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide opacity-50"
  >
    Cart reviewed
  </.component>
  <.component
    component_name="chelekom-content-item"
    site="Global"
    id="checkout-step-address"
    icon="hero-map-pin"
    icon_class="size-4"
    title="Step 2"
    title_class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide opacity-50"
    active
  >
    Delivery address
  </.component>
  <.component
    component_name="chelekom-content-item"
    site="Global"
    id="checkout-step-payment"
    icon="hero-credit-card"
    icon_class="size-4"
    title="Step 3"
    title_class="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide opacity-50"
    class="opacity-50"
  >
    Payment
  </.component>
</.component>

examples.label: Release highlights list under a changelog heading
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="extra_large" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mb-1">What shipped in 1.4 <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mb-5 opacity-70">Three weeks of work, mostly about getting pages out the door faster. <.component component_name="chelekom-content-wrapper" site="Global" id="release-highlights" role="list" class="space-y-5"> <.component component_name="chelekom-content-item" site="Global" id="release-scheduling" icon="hero-clock" icon_class="size-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" title="Scheduled publishing" title_class="font-semibold" > Queue a page and it goes live at the minute you picked, no one awake required. <.component component_name="chelekom-content-item" site="Global" id="release-drafts" icon="hero-document-text" icon_class="size-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" title="Shareable drafts" title_class="font-semibold" > Send a preview link to anyone, no account needed, and it expires when you say so. <.component component_name="chelekom-content-item" site="Global" id="release-speed" icon="hero-bolt" icon_class="size-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" title="Faster rebuilds" title_class="font-semibold" > Editing one section now recompiles that section alone, which took the median save from four seconds to under one.
